purpose: Compact family mechanism ledger for root analyst numerical forecasts; no numerical forecasts or causal weights supplied.
scope: US reported total sales inform mechanisms; management launches may be North America-wide. Do not infer household demand, NA shipments or profit from US total units alone.
method: Reused existing local audits and launch/dealer findings only; no new search. Trajectory describes available pre-disruption or pre-2024 evidence, with no common clean baseline imposed on new or unsplit families.
confidence_definition: Confidence is qualitative evidence strength, not probability. High on observed sales does not imply high confidence in causal explanations or recovery.
global_limits: No owner-level migration matrix or matched national model-level net-price/retail/stock panel.
Operational plans, management explanations and secondary anecdotes retain their original status; none is promoted to independent causal proof.
Forecast assessment should distinguish permanent exits, recovery of existing offers, new-segment entries, and replacement or internal substitution.
No forecast should restore historical peaks or insert 2030 targets solely because a launch is announced.
source_reference_base: Paths are relative to the shared workspace root. URLs are provenance already recorded in files, not newly fetched in this follow-up.

ram_transition.locator: family_assessment; Canadian evidence must retain geography

offer.locator: findings, including Ram trim availability and Gladiator pricing; underlying sources differ in quality

gc_mix.locator: hypothesis_updates and model_use; lender quotations and anecdotes are not national transaction observations

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Pooled pickups weakened before 2024; US pre-2024 LD/HD allocation remains incomplete.
families.strongest_support: Official LD growth and retail improvement; management documents launch/trim constraints.
families.counterevidence: Recovery began before HEMI return; elevated brand inventory and incentives complicate attribution.
families.operational_change_status: HEMI and entry variants restored; sustained profitable replenishment unproved.
families.forward_milestone: Sell-through after relaunch anniversary and repeated availability of desired trims.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Separate support costs, Classic migration and future smaller-pickup substitution.
families.confidence: High on sales; medium on mechanisms; low on causal shares.
families.next_falsifier: Retail share stalls despite normal trim availability, or stock builds as concessions rise.

families.counterevidence: Canadian stability cannot establish US health; modest 2026 YTD total growth is not retail normalization.
families.operational_change_status: 2025 diesel/transmission refresh documented; availability impact not quantified.
families.forward_milestone: Sustained post-refresh deliveries with matched stock and retail/fleet mix.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Finance and business ownership costs matter; do not transfer 1500 HEMI explanation.
families.confidence: High on reported split; low on dominant cause.
families.next_falsifier: HD remains weak after availability normalizes while relevant peers improve.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Sales rose in 2023, reversed in 2024 and weakened further thereafter.
families.strongest_support: Recorded 4xe decomposition explains much of 2024 arithmetic loss; dated commercial changes support mechanisms.
families.counterevidence: Quoted lease terms are unmatched; recalls do not establish the whole decline; retail and total trends differ.
families.operational_change_status: Refresh described; production disruption is a plausible partial explanation, not proven demand.
families.forward_milestone: Post-downtime retail, stock and powertrain/body mix.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Net payments, channel mix and Cherokee/Durango substitution.
families.confidence: High on decomposition; medium on mechanisms; low on attribution.
families.next_falsifier: Supply returns without improved retail share at sustainable prices.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Below 2019 by 2023; fell in 2023 and 2024, then recovered in 2025.
families.strongest_support: Peer screen shows underperformance against Bronco; official series confirms recent recovery.
families.counterevidence: Both models fell in 2023; peer availability differs. No matched causal payment/stock panel.
families.operational_change_status: Heritage renewal and editions planned; exact redesign date unverified.
families.forward_milestone: Retail retention and turn after current offers normalize.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Keep 4xe inside family; distinguish incentives and Recon/Gladiator substitution.
families.confidence: Medium on trajectory; low on mechanism weights.
families.next_falsifier: Editions and improved availability fail to sustain relative retail share.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Below 2019, but grew through 2023–24; weakened in 2025 and sharply in 2026.
families.strongest_support: Official growth contradicts blanket Jeep weakness; later decline is observed.
families.counterevidence: No model channel split; annual growth was not proof of household recovery. Substitution remains unmeasured.
families.operational_change_status: New generation planned; North American timing not verified from European rollout.
families.forward_milestone: Retail/fleet split, sellable inventory and dated NA production plan.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Entry payments versus compact rivals; combined Compass/Cherokee economics.
families.confidence: High on sales; low on cause.
families.next_falsifier: Retail weakness persists with competitive stocked trims and stable supply.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: 2019 was launch year; 2024 declined from 2023, recovered in 2025, then softened in 2026.
families.strongest_support: Documented MSRP reduction and advertised support coexisted with 2024 volume decline.
families.counterevidence: No constant-availability or matched-payment counterfactual; 2025 rebound argues against permanent rejection.
families.operational_change_status: Heritage renewal planned; precise calendar unspecified.
families.forward_milestone: Repeatable retail growth after incentives and launch comparisons normalize.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Wrangler and future Ram midsize/compact overlap; lower sticker is not lower net payment.
families.confidence: Medium on commercial evidence; low on causal attribution.
families.next_falsifier: Stock replenishes without retail improvement despite effective affordability gains.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Predecessor declined well before shutdown; supply interruptions compounded an already weakening trajectory.
families.strongest_support: Dated disruptions, prior slow turn and management trim restrictions support layered explanation.
families.counterevidence: Chip-to-cheap-trim causation unproved; new-model interest claim lacks conversion data.
families.operational_change_status: HEV selling; Trailhawk orders opened; competitive trims planned H1 2027; localization undated.
families.forward_milestone: Delivered competitive trims and profitable retail conversion.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Count net Jeep growth after Compass/Grand Cherokee substitution and finance support.
families.confidence: Medium on layered mechanism; low on causal shares.
families.next_falsifier: Broader available trims fail to improve economic sell-through.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Newer family lacks 2019 baseline; combined sales grew in 2024, fell in 2025.
families.strongest_support: 2024 family growth disproves universal premium-Jeep collapse; 2026 YTD and Q3 directions differ.
families.counterevidence: No matched retail, incentive or model-margin history; aggregation can hide derivative shifts.
families.operational_change_status: Refresh and propulsion expansion planned; naming scope requires reconciliation.
families.forward_milestone: Combined-family retail and stock through refresh and propulsion deliveries.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Avoid rename double counting; overlap with Grand Cherokee/L, Durango and future Ram SUV.
families.confidence: High on history; low on dominant mechanism.
families.next_falsifier: Refreshed supply increases stock without sustainable family sell-through.

families.counterevidence: No fleet order, upfit backlog or matched competitor evidence identifies the cause.
families.operational_change_status: Future renewal planned; global platform date does not establish NA delivery timing.

families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: ProMaster City may substitute; fleet contracts and service costs need separate economics.
families.confidence: High on trajectory; low on mechanisms.
families.next_falsifier: Available vehicles fail to gain orders despite competitive ownership cost.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Old product sold through 2023, then residual volumes; new vehicle is a different-size offer.
families.strongest_support: Dated plan establishes production/dealer-arrival sequence, unlike an undated concept.
families.counterevidence: Actual SOP, orders and sustainable US demand unverified; predecessor units are not a mature target.

families.pre_disruption_trajectory: Pacifica fell in 2019; combined minivans were nearly flat in 2024 and grew in 2025.

families.counterevidence: No consistent retail/fleet or powertrain split; standalone nameplate changes can mislead.
families.operational_change_status: Refresh/variants described; current offering verified, additional rollout milestones unproved.
families.forward_milestone: Comparable combined-family retail and refresh delivery evidence.
families.pricing_cannibalization_dependency: Include finance support and future Chrysler crossover substitution; reconcile current reporting.
families.confidence: High on classification caveat; low on causal explanation.
families.next_falsifier: Combined retail weakens despite refreshed stock and competitive payments.
